t: This is the Nasser D. Khalili Collection of Islamic Art, which holds 26,000 objects covering almost 1,400 years, from 700 CE to the end of the twentieth century. It is the largest of the eight Khalili Collections, and the largest Islamic art collection in private hands. It's named for Sir Nasser Khalili, a British scholar, collector and philanthropist, who was born in Iran and now lives in London.
